purpose: Timestamped, read-only planning evidence for a realistic DividendX demo. No transactions, transfers, or funds were used.
fetchTimeSemantics: Each fetchedAtUtc is the local file completion time recorded immediately after curl completed, converted to UTC to the nearest second.

underlyingCompanyAnnouncement.responseParaphrase: Coca-Cola declared a $0.53 regular quarterly dividend, payable October 1, 2026 to shareholders of record at the September 15, 2026 close.

globalCorporateActionScan.scanDescription: All eight pages returned by the documented history endpoint at pageSize=100, ordered newest-first. Counts are rows/versions, not unique event IDs.

rawSplitAndUnitSplitRows.notes: [CANCELLED v1] Misscalculation - $100 fee not included in calculation

verifiedConclusions.futureKoxCaveat: The upcoming endpoint returned Scheduled version-1 rows for March, June, and September 2026 events, all already effective. The October 1 company payment belongs to the already-effective September action; it is not a new future xStocks multiplier event.
verifiedConclusions.realControlScopeCaveat: Valid only as an event-level rejection/classification control. A separate unsupported SpinOff at 2026-06-29T23:55:00.000Z means HONx is not a pure-split full-day history or a supported live end-to-end series.
verifiedConclusions.correctionAndStatusCaveat: The 732-row history contained Initial, Corrected, and Cancelled versions. KOx latest v2 and HONx reverse-split v2 are status Initial; the API exposed no terminal Final status in these records. Upcoming also retained stale Scheduled versions. Consumers must resolve eventId/version, reject Cancelled rows, and corroborate the active onchain multiplier before settlement.
